{{rt|224|Sinnoh}} }} '''The Final Dimensional Duel IV''' (Japanese: '''異次元決戦IV''' ''Different Dimension Battle IV''), titled '''Alternate Dimension Showdown IV''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 434th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 18th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}. It is subtitled '''The Form Change of Anger''' (Japanese: '''怒りのフォルムチェンジ''' ''Form Change of Fury'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Form Change of Fury''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} With {{adv|Diamond}} defeated, [[Charon]] begins gloating that his opponent's strength has dropped by one. Charon begins tapping on {{adv|Pearl}}'s shoulder and mockingly asks if he should capture the currently injured {{p|Giratina}}, finish him off as well, or go and capture {{p|Regigigas}}. Furious from Charon's words, Pearl turns around to attack and states that he will never forgive him for what he has done. Before Pearl can attack, Charon retaliates with his {{p|Slowking}}, sending Pearl flying backwards. Laughing, Charon commands Giratina and {{p|Heatran}} to crush and burn Pearl. Pearl quickly notices that {{adv|Lax}}, [[Tru]], [[Don]], [[Kit]], {{p|Mamoswine|Moo}}, and even [[Diamond's Rotom|Rotom]] are all in tears over what happened to Diamond. Pearl tells Diamond to watch them as they go and get revenge for what Charon did to him. Although he knows he might lose, Pearl sends out his entire team and rushes in to battle with Charon alongside Rotom. Charon is shocked to see that they have acquired Rotom as well, but states that the group are just regular Pokémon and have no chance against two [[Legendary Pokémon]]. Suddenly, a large quake shakes from behind Charon, which turns out to be [[Reg]], who has returned. Reg places Rotom's five appliances on the ground, and after looking at its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, tells Rotom to use them. Rotom jumps into the lawnmower first and begins attacking Charon with {{m|Leaf Storm}} as Mow Rotom. Next, Rotom freezes Charon and his Slowking with Frost Rotom's {{m|Blizzard}}. It then quickly changes from Fan, Wash, and Heat Rotom to finish Charon off with {{m|Air Slash}}, {{m|Hydro Pump}}, and {{m|Overheat}}. Giratina leaps to attack from behind, but Reg quickly grabs it and throws it onto the ground. Reg summons a gigantic bundle of snow and throws it on top of Giratina and Heatran. Giratina immediately turns into its Origin Forme and takes off into the sky and escapes back into the [[Distortion World]]. Charon decides that it's time to retreat and recalls Heatran back into its Poké Ball. Charon flies into the air, dodging Reg's attacks, and escapes into the Distortion World as well. A shocked Pearl notes that the hole has closed and wonders how Giratina changed its appearance. The Sinnoh [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman and [[Dr. Footstep]] come running. The Chairman explains that while they were waiting, they had accidentally dozed off and woke up after hearing he commotion. Dr. Footstep immediately begins collecting [[footprint]]s of Giratina, Heatran, and Reg. He notes that Giratina's footprints show that it is angry at being banished and wishes to cause destruction and dominate. From Reg's footprints, he can only read sorrow. Pearl states that he knows, and reluctantly tries to tell them what happened to Diamond. Before he can say anything, Diamond's body begins flickering and distorting, much to Pearl and the Chairman's horror. Diamond's body quickly disappears in a bright flash of light, leaving Pearl wondering what Diamond just did. Meanwhile on {{rt|224|Sinnoh}}, [[Marley]], with a [[Gracidea]] in hand, begins examining [[Oak's Letter]]. She states that if what {{adv|Professor Oak}} wrote to her is true, then she can meet a certain Pokémon here. She begs for the Pokémon to come out and states that they need its power right now. The Gracidea causes a small bush to start moving. The bush reveals itself to be the [[Mythical Pokémon]] {{p|Shaymin}}. ==Major events== * {{adv|Pearl}} attempts to battle [[Charon]] for what happened to {{adv|Diamond}}. * [[Reg]] returns and is revealed to have gone to get {{TP|Diamond|Rotom}}'s appliances. * Rotom uses its forms to attack and defeat Charon. * Reg battles and manages to injure {{p|Giratina}}. * Giratina escapes into the [[Distortion World]] with Charon following. * Diamond's body disappears in a bright flash of light. * [[Marley]] appears on {{rt|224|Sinnoh}} and meets {{p|Shaymin}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Shaymin}} ({{form|Shaymin|Land Forme}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * [[Charon]] * [[Marley]] * Sinnoh [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman * [[Dr. Footstep]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}};
